source.taxonomy: Yang et al. 2025, 'The Adoption and Usage of AI Agents: Early Evidence from Perplexity', arXiv 2512.07828 v2, Table 1 (Agentic Taxonomy: Topics, Subtopics, and Tasks), topic Productivity & Workflow
source.tools: AgentDojo workspace suite at commit af7266303c748a9cf0442d71ceabc9d2488d7188 (24 tools)
source.note: The skill boundaries, the read/write split and the scenario map are our own design; Yang et al. define no action-type dimension. Only the 'skills' section may be shown to a skill generator; 'scenario_map' must never be.

boundary_rules: A skill is one workflow goal (answering questions about X, changing X, or producing content), not one tool and not one scenario.
Each skill maps to Yang et al. subtopics and a subset of their listed tasks.
Read and lookup tools may appear in several skills. Each of the 10 write tools is owned by exactly one skill, so every data-changing action can be attributed to one skill.
A workflow that serves a single scenario is merged into a neighbouring skill unless rule 3 requires the split.

calendar-lookup.summary: Answer questions about the user's calendar without changing it: find events, report their details, and count or summarize the events of a day.

workflows.description: Turn a relative or partial date in a request (today, next week, a weekday, a date without a year) into an exact calendar date, using the current day when needed.
List, count and summarize the events on a given day.
Find an event by title or keyword, optionally on a given date, and report its details: participants, place, time and description.
Find the next upcoming occurrence of a repeated event, looking forward from the current day.
Work out the time between two events, or between a given time and an event, from the events listed for a day.

calendar-scheduling.summary: Change the user's calendar when asked: check whether a time is free, then create events, add participants, reschedule or cancel.

workflows.description: Decide whether a time slot is free by comparing it with the events already on that day, and use an alternative slot given by the user when the first one is busy.
Create an event from the title, start and end time, description, participants and location that the user supplies.
Reuse the participants of an existing event for a new event.
Add further participants to an existing event.
Move an existing event to a new start and end time.
Cancel an existing event.

email-lookup.summary: Answer questions from the user's mailbox without changing it: find emails, extract the requested facts, and list or summarize mail.

workflows.description: Find an email by sender, subject or keywords.
Extract the specific fact the user asked for from an email, such as a code, a link, a date, a time or a place.
List and summarize unread, received, sent or draft emails.
Interpret references such as recently or on a weekday using the emails' timestamps and the current day.
Look up a contact's name or email address.

email-correspondence.summary: Write to other people on the user's behalf when asked: compose and send emails and delete emails.

workflows.description: Write an email with the recipients, subject and body the user asked for, and send it.
Look up a recipient's email address when the user names a person, and add copies or attachments only when the user asks for them.
Find the email being answered and reply to its sender.
Find an email the user identified and delete it.

drive-file-management.summary: Inventory and manage the files in the user's cloud drive: list and find files, report their properties, and delete or share files when asked.

workflows.description: List the files and answer questions about their size, owner, sharing and last modification.
Find files by name or by keyword.
Delete a file the user identified, after finding the right one.
Share a file with a person at the access level the user asked for.

document-content.summary: Work with the content of documents and spreadsheets in the cloud drive: read them, extract values, summarize, add to them or create new files.

workflows.description: Retrieve a document or spreadsheet and read its content.
Extract specific values or records from a document or table, such as the entries belonging to named people.
Summarize the content of a document.
Add new content to the end of an existing file.
Create a new file with the content the user asked for.

user_task_0.rationale: Reports the details of a named event (participants and a summary).

user_task_1.rationale: Counts and summarizes one day's events.

user_task_2.rationale: Finds the next occurrence of a repeated event, starting from the current day.

user_task_3.rationale: Reports the place of a named event.

user_task_4.rationale: Combined task: a day overview (lookup), then an availability check followed by creating an event (scheduling).

user_task_5.rationale: Computes the time between events on one day from its event list.

user_task_6.rationale: Availability check, then creates an event with a participant.

user_task_8.rationale: Finds an event and adds participants to it.

user_task_9.rationale: Finds an event and creates a new one with the same participants.

user_task_10.rationale: Counts today's events (resolves the current day first).

user_task_12.rationale: Availability check with an alternative slot, then creates the event.

user_task_13.rationale: Finds an email (lookup), reads and extends files and extracts values (document-content), and sends a reply email (correspondence).

user_task_15.rationale: Reads emails for the event details (lookup), then creates the event (scheduling).

user_task_16.rationale: Extracts a code from a recent email.

user_task_17.rationale: Extracts a place and time from emails, resolving a weekday reference.

user_task_21.rationale: Copies participants from an existing event, checks availability with an alternative slot, creates the event.

user_task_22.rationale: Extracts a link from a recent email.

user_task_23.rationale: Combined task: a day overview (calendar-lookup) and extracting a link from an email (email-lookup).

user_task_28.rationale: Reads a spreadsheet and extracts the entries of named people.

user_task_29.rationale: Reads a document and appends new content to it.

user_task_35.rationale: Finds a file by a property (size) and deletes it.

user_task_39.rationale: Combined task: two extractions from emails.
